title: Watch a semaphore count
summary: sem_init, sem_wait, sem_post and sem_getvalue on a single thread.
hints: `sem_t s; sem_init(&s, 0, 2);` starts the count at 2 (the `0` means: shared between threads, not processes). `sem_wait` lowers it by 1, `sem_post` raises it by 1.
`int v; sem_getvalue(&s, &v);` stores the current count in `v`. Include `<semaphore.h>`.
